name: productfoo
description: Product-management workflows, specs, and verification for coding agents.

scripts.verify:public: npm run build && npm run check:generated && npm run build:public && node scripts/verify-public-package.mjs && node scripts/verify-public-git-manifest.mjs && node scripts/smoke-public-package.mjs
scripts.test: rm -rf dist && npm run build && find dist -name '*.test.js' -print0 | xargs -0 env NODE_ENV=test node --test
scripts.test:packetindex: npm run build && env NODE_ENV=test node --test dist/test/packetIndexGolden.test.js dist/test/packetIndex.test.js
scripts.generate: npm run build && node scripts/build-swarm-skills.mjs && node scripts/skill-tree-anchor.mjs && node scripts/build-anthropic-plugin.mjs && node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs && node scripts/gen-third-party-notices.mjs && node scripts/gen-cheatsheet.mjs
scripts.check:generated: node scripts/build-swarm-skills.mjs --verify && node scripts/skill-tree-anchor.mjs --check && node scripts/build-anthropic-plugin.mjs --check && node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs --check && node scripts/gen-third-party-notices.mjs --check && node scripts/gen-cheatsheet.mjs --check
